name: phi_otdr_acquisition_robust_open_world_v2
era_semantics: filename-derived acquisition era only; not a verified site, subject, fiber, environment, or interrogator identity
legacy_exposure: All files were inventoried in v1. The v1 final query was evaluated under a mixed-era protocol, and non-final v1 sessions informed fixed exploratory cross-era diagnostics. V2 target queries are locked prospectively for v2 method development but are not globally untouched historical data.

development_access.source_validation: model selection, early stopping, hyperparameter selection, stop/go decisions, and inner pseudo-unknown enrollment episodes
development_access.target_calibration: target-known decision thresholds only; held-out unknown class excluded in each fold
development_access.target_support: post-detection enrollment candidates only; complete sessions; never mixed with target query
development_access.target_query: one locked confirmatory evaluation after all development choices are frozen

target_query_policy: No fitting, preprocessing selection, representation selection, model selection, early stopping, threshold calibration, support selection, stop/go decision, or protocol revision may use target_query data or metrics.
outer_protocol: two acquisition directions times six leave-one-class-out folds

calibration_modes.primary: known target_calibration sessions with the held-out class excluded

provisional_stop_go_gates.trajectory: continue if source-validation inner episodes improve enrollment H, worst-class recall, worst-draw stability, or calibrated risk materially over mean pooling
provisional_stop_go_gates.active_enrollment: continue if a deterministic selector improves low-shot or worst-draw behavior over random support
provisional_stop_go_gates.morphology_factorization: continue if cross-era confirmation improves without unacceptable within-era discrimination or calibration loss
provisional_stop_go_gates.tokenization: attempt only after continuous distributional modeling; retain only with predictive or inspectability value

uncertainty: session or held-out-class clustered intervals; paired comparisons across held-out classes and acquisition directions; multiple CUDA seeds for stochastic neural conclusions
cuda_policy: all eligible neural training and inference must assert CUDA availability and log GPU, CUDA/PyTorch versions, precision, peak memory, runtime, and inference time; no silent CPU fallback
